The feature was shipped the same day (2026-06-23) via PR #1844 using a different implementation — Next.js API routes under product/lead-response/dashboard/app/api/admin/sales-cockpit/. The outreach_log table was also created via scripts/db/create-outreach-log-table.sql in PR #1844. A prior investigation (PR #1857, commit d38c62fe) already documented the original branch as superseded.
rootCauseAnalysis.fix: Investigation complete — this rescue branch duplicates work already shipped in PR #1844. The branch contains valid but superseded code (Express routes for a feature now implemented as Next.js routes). Safe to delete. No PR should be filed.
